episodes.name: Heart of Queens
episodes.plot: While Brianna deals with the shattering truths of her marriage, Jill risks losing the safe community she has built for herself when she decides it is time to stop living a lie and comes clean about who she really is. Meanwhile, after a fateful meeting with Cam’ron, Naomi struggles with finally putting herself first

episodes.name: Who You Calling A Bitch?
episodes.plot: After a bad concert review, the women come to terms with the fact that their old image and music no longer serve them; and while Naomi struggles to maintain creative control, Brianna argues for a more collaborative group effort. Meanwhile, Eric takes Valeria out to dinner and dancing in hopes of inspiring her creativity. Later, Naomi gets a second chance to prove herself to JoJo

episodes.name: Ain't No Sunshine

episodes.name: Do Anything For Clout
episodes.plot: As Brianna deals with a painful reminder of Jeff’s infidelity, the group hopes a performance at the American Music Awards will solidify their comeback. Meanwhile, after completing treatment at a rehab facility for her addiction issues, Lauren struggles to identify with her alter ego, Lil Muffin.

episodes.name: Behind The Throne
episodes.plot: As the ladies prepare to shoot their first music video in nearly two decades, Brianna has a hard time maintaining a work-life balance. Meanwhile, Lil Muffin works to reestablish her career, and Jill continues to manage her public image.

episodes.name: Who Shot Ya
episodes.plot: Jill comes clean with the ladies after being invited to collaborate on a track with Wyclef Jean. In addition, Valeria suffers a heart-wrenching betrayal and Eric makes a promise to Jadakiss that he may not be able to keep

episodes.name: God’s Plan
episodes.plot: When tragedy strikes the group, the ladies take a moment to reflect on the beginning stages of their friendship in the early ‘90s when a young Brianna, Naomi and Jill first met. Elsewhere, Valeria fights for an opportunity to lean into her Puerto Rican heritage

overview.value:
Queens – Regine dell’Hip Hop racconta la storia di un gruppo di donne che a fine anni ’90 avevano ottenuto successo con un gruppo hip-hop chiamato Nasty Bitches. Ma come spesso capita la fama è dura da mantenere e tra liti, rivalità e gelosie il gruppo si spacca e le ragazze si perdono di vista.

Anni dopo, ormai quarantenni, si ritrovano per caso quando la loro hit Nasty Girl torna in auge, con una rapper che vorrebbe riportarle sul palco. La fama torna a bussare alla porta delle Nasty Bitches, sarà la volta buona per ottenere il successo tanto agognato?

translations.overview:
Queens – Regine dell’Hip Hop racconta la storia di un gruppo di donne che a fine anni ’90 avevano ottenuto successo con un gruppo hip-hop chiamato Nasty Bitches. Ma come spesso capita la fama è dura da mantenere e tra liti, rivalità e gelosie il gruppo si spacca e le ragazze si perdono di vista.

Anni dopo, ormai quarantenni, si ritrovano per caso quando la loro hit Nasty Girl torna in auge, con una rapper che vorrebbe riportarle sul palco. La fama torna a bussare alla porta delle Nasty Bitches, sarà la volta buona per ottenere il successo tanto agognato?

Estranged and out-of-touch, four women in their 40s reunite for a chance to recapture their fame and regain the swagger they had as the Nasty Bitches—their ‘90s group that made them legends in the hip-hop world.
